name: io.github.exoz00rd/azuremcp
description: MCP server for Azure DevOps Server (on-premises) with PAT authentication.

environmentVariables.name: ADOS_COLLECTION_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full Azure DevOps Server collection URL, e.g. https://devops.example.local/DefaultCollection

environmentVariables.name: ADOS_PAT
environmentVariables.description: Personal Access Token used for all REST calls

environmentVariables.name: ADOS_DEFAULT_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Default project used when a tool call does not specify one

environmentVariables.name: ADOS_API_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Override of the REST API version, defaults to 7.0
